name: Moladah
brief: Town in the Negev, allotted to Judah and Simeon
short: Moladah was a town in the Negev region, allotted to the tribes of Judah and Simeon, and later inhabited by the people of Judah after the Babylonian exile (<ref="Josh 15:26; 19:2; 1Ch.4.28; Neh.11.26">Josh 15:26; 19:2; 1Ch.4.28; Neh.11.26</ref>).
